description:
Run graph sanity checks, health diagnostics, reference validation, audit chain verification, and storage maintenance (actions: validate, doctor, check_refs, audit_chain, compact, archive, prune_events, version, dedupe). Use run_diagnostics instead of get_analytics when performing database repair, AST reference auto-healing, or verifying SHA-256 event hash chains.

Returns validation diagnostics, health report, broken reference repair log, Merkle chain audit, or maintenance stats.

action.description: The diagnostic or maintenance action to execute: validate, doctor, check_refs, audit_chain, compact, archive, prune_events, version, dedupe.

apply.description: For dedupe action: whether to apply merging (default: false for dry-run).

auto_heal.description: Automatically fix broken file references on check_refs.

older_than_days.description: Age threshold in days for archive (default: 30).

preserve_types.description: Event types to preserve from pruning.

prune_orphaned_edges.description: Whether to prune dangling edges during compact.

name: run_diagnostics
